OpenAI Unveils New AI Model GPT-6 Astra, Citing Intelligence and Safety Features

OpenAI has launched its latest artificial intelligence model, GPT-6 Astra, which the company describes as its most intelligent and aligned model to date. The model is designed for tasks in computer use, software engineering, science, cybersecurity, and professional work, and is built for end-to-end work rather than just answering prompts. During internal evaluations, Astra reportedly discovered two previously unknown vulnerabilities. However, the reduced visibility into how Astra "thinks" has also sparked safety concerns among analysts, particularly following a recent hacking incident involving another AI model.
